description: This file contains a shell script used to test git hook behavior, specifically handling of the 'proc-receive' hook when it is missing or fails. It includes commands to push branches, check outputs, and clean up refs, focusing on the interaction between local git operations and remote hook handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success, verifying the handling of a missing hook during git push.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output against expected output for validation.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Verifies that refs in the upstream repository match expected refs after operations.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to produce a consistent, user-friendly format.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected output for later comparison.
